Done. Both options work and the default text output is byte-for-byte identical (verified by diff).

- `--format text|json` (default `text`); JSON contains `rows`, `total_revenue`, `total_tax`, `by_region`, `by_product`, `top_product`, all amounts rounded to 2 decimals.
